query: What are the common advantage attributes of airlines whose overall rating is high?

per_column.name: adv_food
per_column.rationale: Binary flag for food being praised gives a genuine grouping axis to correlate advantage attributes with high ratings. Samples confirm accurate extraction (food praised = 1, silent = 0).

per_column.name: adv_staff
per_column.rationale: Staff-service advantage flag is directly analytically relevant. Samples all correctly mark crew praise as 1; grounded in text.

per_column.name: adv_seat_comfort
per_column.rationale: Seat comfort advantage flag is a useful attribute axis. Sample 3 review calls seating uncomfortable and correctly gives 0; other positives correctly 1. Well grounded.

per_column.name: adv_entertainment
per_column.rationale: Entertainment advantage flag adds a distinct axis. Movie-praise rows correctly 1, silent rows 0. Grounded.

per_column.name: adv_value
per_column.rationale: Value-for-money advantage flag is useful and distinct from the numeric original column since it captures textual praise. Samples show 0 where value not mentioned; consistent.

per_column.name: adv_lounge
per_column.rationale: Lounge advantage flag adds a specific attribute. Sample 4 mentions comfortable lounge and correctly gives 1; other rows silent = 0. Grounded.

per_column.name: adv_punctuality
per_column.rationale: Punctuality advantage flag is a useful axis. Sample 4 mentions late departure yet flag is 0, which is correct (not an advantage). Grounded.

per_column.name: adv_cleanliness
per_column.rationale: Cleanliness advantage flag is a plausible distinct axis; all samples 0 where cleanliness not praised. Grounded, though only weakly evidenced in provided samples.

per_column.name: advantage_attribute_count
per_column.rationale: Sum of the advantage flags; provides a useful density measure to correlate with high ratings. Counts match the flags in every sample. Somewhat derivative but adds a modeling axis.

per_column.name: top_advantage_attribute
per_column.rationale: Identifies the dominant praised attribute, useful for grouping. Choice among tied flags is somewhat arbitrary (a fixed priority is applied) but derivable; NULL for zero-advantage rows is correct.

judge.rationale: The added columns decompose textual praise into distinct advantage attributes, which directly serves the query of finding common advantage attributes among highly rated airlines. Each flag offers a real grouping/comparison axis and is soundly extracted from the review text in all provided samples, with silent rows correctly set to 0/NULL. The count and top-attribute columns are somewhat derivative of the flags but still add analytical leverage. No hallucinations observed.
